prompts.cast:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: eight-character production lineup for an original 3D Japanese life-simulation game, NEW JRPG art direction
Input image roles: IMAGE 1 is our eight-resident design/identity reference ONLY (order, ages, haircuts, clothing colors). IMAGE 2 and IMAGE 3 are official in-game visual-language references from Trails in the Sky the 1st / the 2nd, for anime-game face construction, hair shading and 3D rendering ONLY. Create a new image of OUR residents.
Primary request: transform our cast decisively into the refined JAPANESE ANIME 3D JRPG model language exemplified by the modern Trails in the Sky the 1st and the 2nd remakes. Slim, elegant anime silhouettes, clean narrow face contours, expressive almond-shaped anime eyes with crisp iris highlights, tiny modeled noses, thin expressive eyebrows, hair made of sharp clean sculpted locks with graphic highlight bands. Rebuild the figures as real-time cel/toon-shaded 3D game models. The result must look like 3D JRPG character models under diffuse studio lighting, with readable volume and a few clean light/shadow planes, NOT a flat 2D drawing.
Crucial changed proportions: ALL adults approximately SIX head-heights tall, heads about one sixth total standing height. Clearly longer legs, structured adult shoulders and slender human torsos than input 1. Discard input 1's oversized toy heads, round cheeks, doll anatomy, fuzzy skin, realistic cloth weave and photographic miniature shading. Seven-year-old child about four head-heights tall and around two-thirds adult height. Older adults should still clearly look 65-68, with silver hair, mature eyelid and facial lines, not de-aged teenagers.
Exactly EIGHT residents in ONE evenly spaced full-body lineup, left to right:
1 NAGISA, Japanese woman 36, neat short dark bob, composed warm adult anime face; sage collared blouse with rolled forearm sleeves, burnt-terracotta bib apron with brass strap buttons and front waist bow, cream tapered cuffed trousers, brown low flat shoes.
2 RYO, Japanese man 37, wavy short dark hair with distinct anime locks, gentle mature face; indigo overshirt over ivory T-shirt, beige trousers, ivory sneakers; taller and leaner.
3 RIN, Japanese child age 7, tousled short dark hair, lively anime expression; mustard short overalls over an ivory tee, socks, brown sneakers; distinctly child-sized.
4 OSAMU, Japanese man 68, swept silver hair, round thin spectacles, mature kind square face and subtle smile lines, slightly stockier; oatmeal rolled-sleeve work shirt, deep teal work apron, slate trousers, sturdy brown shoes.
5 FUMI, Japanese woman 65, silver bob, warm mature expressive eyes, fine age lines; ochre cardigan over cream blouse, warm-grey long skirt, brown walking shoes, small camera on neck strap.
6 MAHO, Japanese woman 26, chestnut low ponytail, outgoing anime face distinct from Nagisa; ivory collared blouse, dusty-coral apron, charcoal cropped trousers, brown shoes.
7 RITSU, Japanese adult 31, softly parted dark hair, quiet thoughtful adult anime face; midnight-navy top and ankle trousers, ivory sneakers, grey headphones at neck.
8 AOI, Japanese student age 20, medium shaggy dark hair with defined locks, curious reserved face; moss-green utility jacket over ivory hooded top, charcoal trousers, brown shoes, small mustard-olive backpack.
Outfits remain practical everyday townsfolk clothing, with restrained tailored seams, small metal buttons, clean color blocking and sharp folds; not combat costumes. Preserve the cast's professions and ages.
Presentation: wide landscape 2:1, whole bodies fully visible, equal clear gutters, feet on the same baseline, neutral relaxed standing poses with hands separate from torso, plain cool ivory background, neutral soft studio light. Strong readable individual silhouettes and age differences. Richer local colors with cool blue-grey shadow bands and delicate warm highlights.
Constraints: exactly eight, no repeated figures, no extra portraits, no label text, no typography, no UI, no logos, no watermark. Use only OUR character designs and everyday outfits. No weapons, armor or reference-game character costumes.
prompts.town:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: full-scale environment concept artwork for a 3D JRPG-styled neighborhood life simulation
Input roles: IMAGE 1 is the EXISTING NEIGHBORHOOD layout and building-use reference ONLY. IMAGE 2 is the NEW CANONICAL anime-JRPG resident and rendering design. Produce a new scene using the second image's character style.
Primary request: rebuild the same small neighborhood as an appealing full-scale Japanese anime 3D RPG FIELD ENVIRONMENT, with the clean anime-toon aesthetic, crisp paint-textured architecture, rich clear local colors and luminous daylight associated with modern Trails in the Sky the 1st/the 2nd. This is a living neighborhood at human scale, viewed by an elevated three-quarter gameplay-concept camera. Break away decisively from a photographed toy miniature: no raised island base, no studio cyclorama, no tilt-shift bokeh, no cloth fuzz or photorealistic clay figures.
Setting and layout: keep our contemporary Japanese small-town neighborhood, THREE modest homes, a vintage radio-repair workshop, a friendly bakery-cafe and the shared small square from image 1. Keep dark blue-grey tiled pitched roofs, warm cream plaster and natural timber frames, a sage fabric cafe awning, a broad open workshop doorway, a useful two-person shared bench, a few leafy trees and planters, clear connecting stone and brick paths. One foreground family home has its camera-facing wall and roof cut away so we can see a parent and child working at the dining table. Buildings have clear constructed geometry and walkable entrances. The other houses are whole, with a glimpse of a green hillside neighborhood and vivid blue sky beyond. It is still OUR ordinary town and life-simulation setting.
Daily life: all EIGHT original residents from image 2 appear in their own clothing and age-appropriate proportions, adults around six heads tall, child distinctly shorter. Designer RYO and child RIN make a miniature town at the home table; baker NAGISA in sage blouse and terracotta apron and cafe worker MAHO in pale blouse and coral apron are at the bakery-cafe; older craftsman OSAMU, silver hair and teal apron, works at the repair bench; older woman FUMI in ochre cardigan lifts her camera near a tree; quiet RITSU in navy and headphones sits on the shared bench; student AOI in moss jacket carries a small vintage radio along the path toward the workshop. Natural poses and comfortable distances, no combat or adventure-party lineup.
Rendering: polished real-time 3D JRPG look with anime-shaped faces, slender character silhouettes, sharp hair locks and graphic highlight bands, simple two-to-three-tone shading plus subtle diffuse gradients, restrained fine outline accents, hand-painted clean building textures, stylized foliage grouped into clear masses. Lighting shows 3D volume and coherent shadows. Avoid flat paper-cutout people and photorealistic surfaces.
Composition: wide landscape 3:2, elevated three-quarter field view framing the connected homes, workshop, cafe and square, large enough to read human activities. Crisp focus across the scene. Clear sunny afternoon with blue sky and soft white clouds, warm sunlight and cool blue-grey shaded walls, fresh deep greens and warm amber interiors, brighter broader palette than input 1. Eye follows the shared paths between spaces.
Constraints: no giant hourglass, no floating platform, no oversized heads, no weapons, no game UI, no caption text, no logos or watermark. Original game art concept, not an actual implemented gameplay screenshot.
prompts.nagisa_turnaround:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: anime-JRPG 3D modeling reference, three orthographic views of ONE character
Input image 1 is the CANONICAL NEW JRPG CAST. Use the FIRST person from the left, NAGISA, as the sole character design reference.
Primary request: show the SAME Japanese adult woman baker, age 36, in FRONT, exact LEFT SIDE profile, and BACK view, left to right. All three are matching orthographic views of the same 3D anime-game model, same height, crown and soles aligned on common lines, neutral A-pose with arms 20 degrees away from torso, palms relaxed, feet flat parallel. Full bodies with no crop and generous gaps.
Maintain the NEW JRPG proportion: about SIX own head-heights tall, an adult slender torso, long proportionate legs, visible neck and articulated human elbows/knees/hands. An elegant mature everyday adult anime face; neat dark side-parted bob, amber-brown eyes, gentle composed expression, tiny modeled nose, clean face contour, graphic hair highlight strips. Do not revert to a short chibi/toy body or rounded doll face.
Outfit exactly follows Nagisa in image 1: sage-green collared blouse with rolled forearm sleeves; burnt-terracotta canvas bib apron, small brass strap buttons, front pockets, front waist bow and crossed back straps; cream tapered trousers with rolled ankle cuffs; plain warm-brown low flat shoes. Back shows the coherent X-strap and waist belt construction. Nothing held in hands, no hat or jewelry.
Style: refined modern Japanese 3D JRPG character model, anime/toon shader with clean separated shadow planes and gentle supporting gradients, subtle restrained dark contour edges, smooth opaque skin, clean painted fabric colors and sharp broad folds, layered sculpted anime hair locks. Clear 3D form, not a flat manga illustration. No realistic skin pores, fuzzy fabric weave or photographic miniature lighting.
Composition: wide landscape studio character sheet, exactly three isolated figures at identical scale on a cool ivory background, even diffuse neutral light and tiny soft contact shadows. No additional portraits, props, names, text, labels, typography, logos or watermark. Consistent proportions, hairstyle, apron construction and local colors across every view.

prompts.architecture:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: JRPG-styled architectural game-asset production board, exteriors and dollhouse cutaways
Input roles: IMAGE 1 is our existing building board, a LAYOUT AND BUILDING-FUNCTION reference only. IMAGE 2 is the NEW JRPG TOWN art direction, for color, material painting, lighting and geometry treatment.
Primary request: completely restyle the three building types in image 1 into the clean polished ANIME 3D JRPG environment style of image 2. Clear constructed 3D geometry, hand-painted clean texture color, crisp planes, designed warm/cool shadows, subtle contour accents, slate-blue roof tiles, warm ivory plaster and honey oak. Avoid the old photographic clay-miniature material treatment, soft fuzzy wood or excessive golden-brown wash. These must be useful modeling references for our current Japanese town, not medieval castles or a new country.
Board layout: exactly THREE columns and TWO rows. Each column is ONE building shown twice, complete exterior above and matching roof/front-wall removed cutaway below. Same angle and human scale for each pair, wide clean gaps. Pale cool-ivory studio backdrop with small contact shadows only, no connecting neighborhood ground.
Column 1: bakery-cafe, compact cream plaster single-storey building, dark blue tiled gable roof, sage awning, timber glazed facade and service entrance. One outdoor round table with two teal chairs in the exterior. Interior has customer seating in front, bread display/service counter, a rear preparation bench and compact oven. Clear routes from doorway around tables and behind counter.
Column 2: radio-repair workshop, warm timber frame and muted sage sideboards, dark tiled gable roof, wide glazed sliding front doors. Interior has a rear wall parts cabinet, one private repair bench with its stool, and one separate shared rectangular worktable with TWO usable stools, a small radio, open circulation between them.
Column 3: modest two-storey family house, cream plaster, wood trim, small upper balcony and dark blue tiled gable roof. Matching two-level cutaway with ground-floor entrance, dining/living room, table and three chairs, child craft corner, small kitchen and usable stair; two small upstairs bedrooms. Legible room volumes instead of crowded doll furniture.
Rendering: consistent modern real-time Japanese anime JRPG look, readable beveled building geometry, clean painted textures with simplified grain and plaster, restrained fine detail, richer broad colors, cool blue-grey shadow planes, warm interior illumination. Stylized 3D depth, not a flat floorplan or pencil sketch. No tilt-shift or photographic texture noise.
Composition: wide 3:2 board, coherent elevated three-quarter orthographic-like camera, entire buildings and foundations visible, doors and stair unobscured, equal gutter space. No people, labels, dimension numbers, text, logos or watermark.
